purpose: Define deterministic prerequisites for converting normalized benign provenance events into a causal graph.

PROCESS.canonical_id: sha256(run_id || boot_id || pid || pid_start_time_ticks || executable.sha256 || executable.path)

FILE.path_alias_rule: Device/inode is authoritative; path is retained as an observed alias.

SOCKET.canonical_id: sha256(run_id || netns_inode || socket_inode || family || protocol || local_endpoint || remote_endpoint)
SOCKET.namespace_rule: A socket identity without netns_inode is not graph-joinable to h1/h2.

NETWORK.canonical_id: sha256(run_id || pcap_sha256 || packet_index || packet_timestamp || interface || five_tuple)
NETWORK.packet_rule: Keep unmatched packet records; never fabricate a process/socket owner.

causal_edges.required_proof: Both process identities exist and timestamps are ordered.

causal_edges.join: PROCESS identity to executable FILE identity
causal_edges.required_proof: exec_path plus device/inode or immutable executable hash.
PID/start_ticks, netns/logical host, path/device/inode, syscall result.
Operation=read and successful syscall result or explicit failure.
unlink/rename record with device/inode/path and result.
Live socket inode plus netns and endpoint evidence.
Operation, socket inode, endpoints, and syscall result.

causal_edges.join: SOCKET identity to NETWORK identity by netns, endpoint tuple, time window, interface, and pcap hash
causal_edges.required_proof: Bounded packet record and at least one matching socket/process event; unmatched packets remain unjoined.

validation_gates: Every normalized event has every common contract field, including file_identity and socket_identity fields.
Every PID join includes pid_start_time_ticks or is marked PID_REUSE_UNPROVEN.
Every netns join maps to exactly one logical_host_id and satisfies the four E1A-R2 namespace assertions.
Every process/file/socket edge references existing canonical nodes.
Every edge timestamp is within the source event lifetime and preserves causal order.
Any collector or packet loss is recorded and prevents a complete-graph claim unless explicitly bounded and justified.
Raw bytes hash and decoder version reproduce the normalized event deterministically.
Packet-only observations are never promoted to process provenance without a socket/process join.
Filesystem isolation is not inferred from PID-attributed file events.
